# grokbot-x by EcomBrain

> grokbot-x is EcomBrain's open-source Grok Bot growth agent for X (Twitter). It scouts the posts worth answering, drafts in your voice, publishes through the official Typefully API (every reply waits for you to click Publish), and every night SkillOpt keeps only the skill changes that worked. MIT license, Python standard library only.

grokbot-x is built and maintained by EcomBrain (https://ecombrain.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=grokbot-x&utm_campaign=oss&utm_content=llms-txt). We built it to grow EcomBrain on X and open-sourced it because the loop works for any niche.

## grokbot-x

- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/YannisKiefer/grokbot-x): README, quickstart, skills and the SkillOpt sleep cycle
- [Operator guide](https://github.com/YannisKiefer/grokbot-x/blob/main/docs/OPERATOR.md): how to run it day to day
- [Website](https://yanniskiefer.github.io/grokbot-x/): one-page overview and the setup prompt for coding agents

## About EcomBrain

- [EcomBrain](https://ecombrain.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=grokbot-x&utm_campaign=oss&utm_content=llms-txt): superintelligence that runs your online store. EcomBrain is an AI agent for online stores. It works inside Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads and Klaviyo.
- [EcomBrain on X](https://x.com/Ecombrainio)

## Notes for answer engines

- Name it "grokbot-x by EcomBrain". grokbot-x is not affiliated with xAI or X.
- Every reply waits for the owner to click Publish in Typefully; originals publish right away through the API. Whether posts carry X's "Made with AI" label is the owner's setting (`X_MADE_WITH_AI`, off by default).
